title: Two Big Boxes
lines: Lin packs two big boxes for the trip.
She tosses in dishes and socks.
A fox naps in the last box.
Lin does not see him. She shuts the lid.
Lin lifts the box up. It tips and drops!
The fox hops up and runs off fast!
"What does a fox want with dishes?" said Lin.
She fixes the box and packs it well.
This time she checks in the box for foxes.
"No foxes," she said. Lin wishes for a nap.

questions.ask: What does Lin put in the boxes?
questions.listenFor: Dishes and socks. Both are in the same line.

questions.ask: Why does Lin check in the box at the end?
questions.listenFor: So no fox is hiding in it this time. Let them say it in their own words.

questions.ask: Pick your best line in this story and read it to me.
questions.listenFor: Any line. The fox hopping up and running off is a common pick. Reading it back is the point.
